title: Character chain lifts and ordered cocycles on the internal homogeneous bar
statement:
Let $A$ be a commutative condensed ring on the small coherent profinite site and $G$ a profinite group, with $\underline G(S)=C(S,G)$. Use internal $A$-modules, equivariant internal modules, and the coefficient universes of [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring, sk-def-sfb-module-objects, def-sfb-condensed-action-module, def-weil-size-convention], and ordinary derived categories [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Let $P^{-n}=P_n=A[\underline G^{n+1}]$ for $n\geq0$, and $P^i=0$ for $i>0$, with diagonal left action, differential $d_P^{-n}=\partial_n$ given by alternating deletion, $d_P^0=0$, and augmentation $e:P\to A[0]$ sending $[g]$ to $1$, as in [lem-sfb-condensed-internal-bar-resolution]. Give $A$ trivial action. Shifts have $d_{P[1]}=-d_P$.

For an additive condensed-group map $a:\underline G\to(A,+)$, the natural formulas on generalized generators after every profinite base change
$$L_{a,n}[g_0,\ldots,g_n]=a(g_0^{-1}g_1)[g_1,\ldots,g_n]\quad(n\geq1),\qquad L_a^0=0$$
extend uniquely to equivariant internal $A$-linear maps and define a cochain map $L_a:P\to P[1]$; equivalently $\partial L_a+L_a\partial=0$.

For every $q\geq0$ and ordered list $a_1,\ldots,a_q$ of such maps, set $F_0=1_P$ and
$$F_q=L_{a_q}[q-1]\circ\cdots\circ L_{a_2}[1]\circ L_{a_1}:P\to P[q]\quad(q\geq1).$$
Its component in degree $-n$ is zero if $n<q$ and otherwise is
$$F_q[g_0,\ldots,g_n]=\left(\prod_{k=1}^q a_k(g_{k-1}^{-1}g_k)\right)[g_q,\ldots,g_n].$$
The map $e[q]F_q:P\to A[q]$ has sole component $f_q:P_q\to A$, satisfies $f_q\partial_{q+1}=0$, and under the homogeneous-to-inhomogeneous coordinate change gives the internal $A$-linear cochain map
$$c_q:A[-q]\longrightarrow U^\bullet,\qquad U^n=\underline{\operatorname{Hom}}_A(A[\underline G^n],A),\qquad c_q(g_1,\ldots,g_q)=\prod_{k=1}^q a_k(g_k).$$
Here $U^\bullet$ is the complex of alternating cochains of the inhomogeneous cosimplicial internal-function diagram of [def-sfb-condensed-equivariant-bar-data] for the trivial action (first face dropping $g_1$, interior faces multiplying adjacent entries, last face dropping $g_n$), $f_0=e$, and $c_0=1$. All formulas are natural in the profinite parameter. No projectivity or underived internal-Hom acyclicity is assumed.

proof.text: Use exists_unique_deletion from [lem-sfb-internal-bar-character-deletion] to choose for each character its uniquely specified degree-one deletion cochain map. The endpoint vanishing degreeOne_zero is proved from the zero object in positive degree.

Construct all ordered composites by orderedIterate and the augmentation by barAugmentation, both actual constructions. Their recursion and normalization are proved in [def-sfb-internal-bar-character-data]. Apply ordered_properties to the deletion family for all the homogeneous generator, equivariance and augmented closedness assertions. Package the augmented underlying map with its proved equivariance into the existing action category. Subtype.ext gives its closedness and empty-list normalization. Zero targets of shifted single complexes prove the sole-component assertion.
Independently use [lem-sfb-internal-bar-character-cocycles] for the product cocycle of each list, retaining its formula for every scalar, slice, and tuple.

To establish the coordinate comparison, substitute g_k=x_k^{-1}x_(k+1) in the scalar formula of that cocycle, with T=S, f=id and r=1. Identity restriction preserves 1, so its value is exactly the homogeneous augmented generator product supplied by ordered_properties. This is a literal equality of the specified internal-function evaluation and the actual augmented component. All structure fields of Lifts are now filled by these constructions and proved equalities.
